name: 5W: no report
description: Every morning: a follow-up task for each registered organisation that hasn't reported an activity for a week (or ever, a week after registering). One open task per organisation at a time.

routes.name: no_report
routes.description: No 5W report for a week: the response lead follows it up with the organisation's focal point.
routes.fixedNote: This organisation hasn't reported an activity for over a week: a follow-up task for the response lead (its focal point is on its page).
